correctness.rationale: Complete proof for all integers r>=2,m>=1 and all t>=0: the four spectral subspaces yield the exact heat-evolved hub-leaf signed vector. The polynomial sign inequality r z-(r-1)-z^r<=0 for z in [0,1] locates positive and negative masses, and an explicit transport plan and 1-Lipschitz dual witness match exactly. Edge reduction establishes the global W1 coefficient. Differentiation rigorously yields the unique peak, complete all-time contractivity boundary, and asymptotic limits; no extrapolation of finite computations. The packaged CHECK.py independently passed 270 edge/time LP comparisons, 1380 Dirac pair bounds, 144 random probability-pair checks and 72 peak classifications. Remaining scientific limits: nonunit weights/other topologies and Wp p!=1 not proved.

value.rationale: The result evaluates a natural exact induced transport norm for an infinite, structurally important family of reversible finite graph semigroups. It gives a sharp integer criterion for transient amplification despite positive spectral gap, the exact worst time and amplitude, and demonstrates a surprising disappearance of the intrablock spectral mode from the extremal norm. These quantities are not textbook specializations of a generic spectral gap or first-order curvature formula; their interpretation supplies quantitative benchmarks for transport-vs-spectral contraction.
